thread:
sam_cs: Quick note from a billing review with Horizon (CSM=Priya). They called out three recurring items blocking org rollout: per-route billing toggle, short-context embedding templates, and a downloadable per-route spend CSV for finance. Said treasury flagged renewal risk if not visible.

iza_pm: Can you paste one concrete example and frequency? We need to assess revenue risk.

sam_cs: Example: an analytics job hit one route and generated a surprise $11k charge. Mentioned this at 3 separate meetings this month.

omar_support: Attached support thread & 18s screen clip: https://support.example.com/HZ-410. Workaround is manual throttling from their side.

leo_research: Quick triage: per-route billing = high impact, medium effort; templates = low effort, high usability; CSV export = low effort, medium impact. Suggest tickets per ask.

iza_pm: Good. Omar/Leo - quick T-shirt sizes by EOD? Omar attach artifacts to tickets. I'll open PRD tickets and tag eng.

jira-bot: Created RED-PRD-700 (per-route-billing), RED-PRD-701 (embed-templates), RED-PRD-702 (route-spend-csv). Linked HZ-410.

omar_support: Files uploaded to RED-PRD-700/702.

sam_cs: Next steps: Iza to decide roadmap fit; Omar to add artifacts; Leo to add frequency counts; CSM will request a finance sync if escalation continues. Thanks :thumbsup:
